entries.fffcb32801777f47: In order to realize sustainable growth toward 2030, it sets out 3 basic policies: "strengthening the business base," "building a solid management base that supports the growth strategy," and "management emphasizing environment, society, and governance." As issues to be addressed, it cites diversification of the portfolio through continuing active M&A based on profitability and growth as criteria, stabilization of earnings through expansion of stock-type revenue such as maintenance and parts sales in the industrial furnace combustion equipment-related business, establishment of technological superiority in responses to next-generation fuels such as hydrogen and ammonia, and development of new customers in the electronics business.
